name: Hermes Migration
description: Imports Hermes configuration, memories, skills, and supported credentials into OpenClaw.
recommendedPrompts: Help me preview a Hermes migration. Ask which Hermes home or active profile and OpenClaw agent to use, then run the supported dry-run and explain the proposed memory, skills, MCP, and model-configuration imports. Keep secrets redacted and do not apply changes or activate Hermes plugins, sessions, or jobs.

Help me make a selective Hermes migration plan. Ask which memories, instructions, skills, and connections I want to keep, explain conflicts and unsupported state, and give credential import its own consent decision. Preserve existing OpenClaw data and show the backup and verification plan before any import.
